def fetch(query):
    items=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp=apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='-updated_at')

        if not page:
            break
        items.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>20:
            break
    return items
